en: High Stakes
Collect $1oa Wood Bundles from Turner's Logging Camp for Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep.

One thing that never ceases to amaze me is the drive of humans. They see a desolate warzone teemin' with orcs and cultists and figure that's the perfect spot tae set up shop! Amazin'.

But, it's not me job tae tell 'em where to build. Just gotta show 'em how. And if we want this keep tae be as big as they say, we're gonna need lots o' wood.

With how dangerous the roads have become our lumber shipments from the mill tae the northwest are slowin' to a crawl. Think ye can fetch a few bundles for us?
Fragments of the Pylons
Recover shards and fragments of the pylons, found guarded at the Magram and Gelkis villages. Return them to Mordent Evenshade.

Although I am sure we can attribute the damage to both pylons to the reckless centaur stomping about, I suspect the timing of their rampage resulted in the shards being separated. I know little about their quarrels, but I do know there are at least two main factions that have trespassed into Shen'dralas: the ferocious Magram and the cunning Gelkis.

Keeping these treasures in the midst of a battlefield would be unwise. By now, I am assuming they have taken their trophies back to their own villages.
A Miner Problem
Defeat $1oa Ogre Miners and $2oa Twilight Subjugators in the cave near the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.

We should be thankful that our foe is stupid. An army of ogres at their disposal, and the Twilight's Hammer have them working in the mines nowhere near the fight. I don't know if I chalk it up to mismanagement or an internal struggle, but either way they're in no position to defend themselves.

That's where we come in. With the cult's focus divided, we have an opportunity to strike the enemy while they're vulnerable and split them further. Go to this mine and sow some chaos among their ranks.
The Tempest's Weapons
Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.

Ye did good, and I can see yer itchin' fer yer reward. Sorry tae say, I'm not exactly a dwarf of many possessions.

<Veyric gestures broadly at his remote location.>

Tell ye what, though. I hear a troll named the Windwatcher lives out in the Alterac Mountains. He's a powerful shaman himself, and an expert in storm elementals. If ye bring that there elemental core to him, I bet he can make ye a weapon worthy of yer victory.
Powering the Pylons
Acquire the Mana Sieve from within the temple in Shen'dralas and use it to collect Ancient Mana Crystals. Once you have acquired enough mana, empower the pylons and return to Mordent Evenshade.

You may have seen the floating sparks of mana scattered throughout Shen'dralas. This is a new phenomenon, likely the result of the damage the pylons have endured.

We need this mana back in a semicrystallized form. We can accomplish this by using the Mana Sieve found within the temple. Borrow the sieve and collect any floating mana orbs you find.

The temple's denizens will not appreciate their precious artifact being borrowed without their consent, but they will understand in time.
Step Two: More Rock
Deliver $1oa Heavy Weightstones to Hamur in Bolder'ok.

Dese good rock. Now need finishing touch. More rock.

Only rock can make rock stronger. Dat the way of rocks.

Me see some tinies make extra heavy rock. Bring me heavy rocks and me make weapon.
Camping 101: Leatherworking
Speak with Gretta Finespindle in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
Camping 101: Blacksmithing
Speak with Tognus Flintfire in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
Camping 101: Alchemy
Speak with Vosur Brakthel in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

Now that you've taken up Alchemy, I can also teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp once you've learned a bit. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
Camping 101: Mining
Speak with Yarr Hammerstone in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
Camping 101: First Aid
Speak with Thamner Pol in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
Camping 101: Fishing
Speak with Paxton Ganter near Iceflow Lake in Dun Morogh to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.

There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
Camping 101: Herbalism
Speak with Reyna Stonebranch in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.

There you have it, you can now craft your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
Camping 101: Skinning
Speak with Balthus Stoneflayer in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
Camping 101: Tailoring
Speak with Uthrar Threx in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.

There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
Camping 101: Engineering
Speak with Bronk Guzzlegear in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
Camping 101: Enchanting
Speak with Thonys Pillarstone in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.

It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
Gaseous Gold
Gather 5 Marsh Gas Vials for Sleebo Fizzlespout.

The fuel of the future's not coal, or oil, it's gas, baby! Those marshy ponds to the southwest spew it out by the ton, and I've got just the invention to put it to use--a new type of engine that runs on the stuff. The gas is a real pain to collect, though.

If you feel like making a humble contribution to the future of science and industry, why don't you help me get some of that gas? You can see it coming up from vents near the water.
Rock 'em and Sock 'em
Help Sleebo test his creation.

You may have noticed my mechanical companion here, G45-B4G. Whirlin' around in that burlap chest of his is the one, and only, working prototype of my gas-powered engine.

I figure it's in need of some stress testing. How'd you like to take him on in a fight? I can power him up with the gas you've collected.

Oh, and don't worry about hurting him. He can't feel a thing!
A Tale Spun Around the Fire
Take the tablet etchings to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

$n, we Darkspear keep much of our traditions alive by oral storytelling. We pass legends such as these to the next generation, teaching lessons and weaving cautionary tales to our younglings.

These etchings must be taken to our spiritual leader, Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. He is one of the wisest Darkspear and he will wish to hear the truth of this tale.

I have prepared an extra copy of this tale for you as well. If you ever lose your copy, I would be happy to create another, for a small fee.
Wound Dressings
Gather 20 Mageweave Cloth for Brother Lowley at Farholde Keep.

If there is one thing a fighting force always needs, it's bandages. Unfortunately, Farholde has no reliable way to manufacture cloth. Thus, we depend on imports from the goblins or, if we are lucky, what we can take back from the orcs.

Currently, our supply of quality cloth is running low. I will have to start making bandages of old shirts before long. If you have the means to aid us, you would be saving many lives.
Doctor's Orderly
Bandage up 3 Wounded Soldiers for Brother Lowley.

I will fashion the cloth you've given me into bandages. In the meantime, please take these ones that I have already made, and dress the wounds of the soldiers who need it. It should be a matter of basic first aid.

Your assistance here is both necessary, and highly appreciated. I simply cannot be everywhere at once.
Clerical Quarantine
Speak to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.

You have done all you can here, for now.

If you wish to be of further aid, go up the hill to the chapel. It is the smaller building outside the main church.

Sister Rowland is looking after a few quarantined soldiers there who have contracted an unknown illness.
Something's in the Water
Collect a sample of drinking water from the plains for Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.

I will spare you the grisly details, but these soldiers are violently ill. The nature of their sickness leads me to believe there is an issue with either their food or their water.

I've already checked the crops coming in from the nearby farms, so this only leaves the water, which comes from the local rivers. The best place to collect a sample is from the pools in the plains to the north. Nearly every river runs through the area, so it would be wise to check for contamination there.
Upstream Contamination
Find whatever creature is causing the drinking water contamination and eliminate it. Then, return to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.

The impurities in this sample look organic in nature. Not quite waste, but certainly something toxic.

I am no expert on wildlife, but I would guess that there is something upstream causing the water contamination. Some kind of animal, or at least a creature.

Follow the rivers as far north as you can, and see if you can find what is responsible for this. If it is an animal, it must be put down. It is for the safety of all here in Farholde.
The Great Outdoors
Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors is critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.

So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
Camping 101: Tailoring
Speak with Snang in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
A Feast for Buzzards
Bring the Gnawed Skull to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery.

You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to a hunter at Rog'mar and see what they know.
Song of the Strider
Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one is especially large--the leader of the nearby pride.

I would gladly hunt the beast myself, but you have first claim. Instead, I will aid you.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. You can use it to lure the lion out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound.

There are tallstriders all over the plains. Find me a beak and the hunt can begin!
King of the Wild Plains
Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

The whistle is made, $n.

Take it and go to the top of the hill south where the lions dwell.

Once you are ready to face your quarry, blow the whistle and the beast should appear.

I wish you luck in your hunt. May you return in glory.
Feathers for Fletching
Bring $1oa Plains Buzzard Feathers to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

A hunter goes through more arrows in her lifetime than there are stars in the sky.

Personally, I make mine by hand. I only trust my own work.

The coarse feathers of the nearby buzzards make for excellent fletching. Would you aid me by collecting a few?
Poison Tips
Bring 4 samples of Glade Viper Venom to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

Arrows are always essential, but sometimes you need something more potent to take down your prey.

This is where poison coatings come into play. They ruin the meat, but if you need something dead, they do the job.

Poisons can either be brewed or, if you are brave, gathered. You strike me as the latter.

The vipers by the pools to the south produce a powerful venom. If I have estimated you correctly, I think you could collect some of it.
A Hunter's Quiver
Gather 6 Prized Lion Hides for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

As important as a hunter's weapons is her quiver. A good quiver holds many arrows, while not being so large as to slow the wearer down. It must be durable, and fit snugly onto the body.

Around here, there is no better material for a quiver than the pelts of lions. They are already well-suited for the life of a hunter on the plains.

The lions gather on a hill to the south. You can see it from here. Please, bring me their pelts.
In Need of Relief
Find Dunston Willis somewhere among the ogres in Bolder'ok.

Now that the lion hides have been collected, and the orcish poachers culled, I can finally get a break.

At least, that's what I would say, if the man who was supposed to relieve me of my watch wasn't missing.

Dunston Willis, explorer extraordinaire, went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north a few days ago. He said he'd take over my post upon his return.

Find him. If he's alive, bring him back here. If he's hanging up on meat hooks, bring me proof so Demar can send me someone else.
An Ogre's Captive
Find Gronok the Butcher, kill him, and bring Dunston the key to his shackles.

I'm not sure how you got in here, but please, listen to me.

As you know, I serve as a watchman for Farholde Keep.

While on patrol, I was ambushed by a band of these brutes and taken prisoner. Now, I am forced to fight in the ring for their amusement.

I haven't much strength left. If I'm to escape, it's now or never. 

My captor is an ogre they call "Gronok the Butcher". He has the key to my shackles. Will you bring me that key and help me out of here?
Chakuyak
Defeat Chakuyak and bring back her pelt.

Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
Have you found the big wolf?
Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.
Heed My Call
Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.

Euck, just bein' around these blasted totems is givin' me the willies--but that's good. This much twisted corruption will be exactly what we need tae summon the quilboar's elementals.

Go to the Thousand Needles and find a suitable spot for your defenses. The steam pools should work. They're rich with fire, earth, water, and air alike. Place these totems and be ready for a fight. The Razormane won't take too kindly to yer interference.
Call of Air
Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.

As you have no doubt experienced yourself, the elements of Azeroth are unique to those in Zephras. It is one thing to channel the forces of nature within the elemental plains, and another thing entirely to do it down here in the muck.

I could grant you your totem of air, but I think it would do you more good to meet with the one who trains the other earth-bound initiates. What say you, $n?
Ira's Dagger
Defeat $1oa Young Black Ravagers and $2oa Black Ravagers then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.

A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.
Merrick's Bow
Defeat $1oa Splinter Fist Warriors and $2oa Splinter Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.

A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.
The Valor Family
Search Raven Hill for anything of interest and return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.

In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.

This tome appears to be about the Valor family. I believe I've heard of a few of them. Good folk. Not sure they merit an entire book about them.

I'll make you a copy of the tome. If you see anything else related to them on your travels, I'll be happy to take it off your hands.
The Windshaper's Wrath
Accompany Lumina Windsinger and help her escape Fenris Keep.

Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, $c.

Thank you again, $N. I've been aquatinting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail.

I've heard... less than charitable things about paladins thus far in my travels. As a sky-touched shen'dorei elf traveling through horde territory, I can certainly understand how easily intolerance and prejudice can take root. 

You and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.
Khan Hratha
Bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Umarak in the Desolace.

While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.

Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.

Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.
Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon
Use the Toxin Extractor to gather $1oa Gloomrise Toxin Samples from the Gnawed Corpses at Gloomrise.

Something funny be happenin' over there at Gloomrise. Ol' Mazu'kon be hearin all about these nasty new beasties skitterin' all around there.

Some say those creepy crawlies got a venom that have some unique properties and this be gettin' me curious. Take my extractor. Use it on the dead bodies layin' around that place to harvest the venom. Do this and I be in ya debt, mon.
Call of Earth
Find Teo Hammerstorm in Dun Morogh.

It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave Shaman. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
Defending the Dead
Kill $1oa Gloomrise Hatchlings and $2oa Gloomrise Soldiers.

There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.

It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.
Stronger than Steel
Gather $1oa strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.

Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
The Broodmother
Kill Broodmother Valraxx at Gloomrise.

As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.

If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.
Elemental Aid
Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.

So yer a big shot shaman now, eh? Ye've mastered the elements and want tae put 'em to good use? I think I got just the thing.

If ye want the elements' respect, ye gotta repay yer debts to 'em. They help you, you help them. And right now they need all the help they can get from those who would abuse their power.

Earth's rumblin', $n. It speaks of the quilboar amassin' for some ritual of terrible power. We need tae go investigate their kraul and see what they're up to. Bring me back whatever ye find.
A Darker Truth
Bring the letter you recovered from Broodmother Valraxx to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.

<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise.

You notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>
Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle
Legacy Reward: Spectral Bear Cub
Nip 'Em in the Bud
Slay $1oa Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh.

Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
How'd it go? Did ye give 'em what-for?

These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs.

Hopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.
Underground Map
Deliver the Dark Iron Map to Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh.

The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.
Oh what's this, then?

Judging by this map, it certainly looks like these Dark Irons are planning some sort of incursion into the vaults beneath Ironforge. The band ye busted up to the east must be a scouting force.

Thank ye for bringing me this. If we hurry, we might be able to beat them to whatever their goal is down there.
Farsen's Watch
Speak with Earthseer Farsen and ask him to lend you his far sight to observe the Dark Iron threat.

Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.

If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
Far sight can show ye a great many things, even things ye'd rather not see.
So ye see now, $C? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.$B$BYe look like a sturdy enough sort. How's about a bit o' violence?
Old Ironforge Incursion
Enter the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge and claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer.

Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. 

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. 

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
What do ye need, citizen?

A Dark Iron incursion--right beneath our feet? Well, I'm relieved to hear that the Dark Iron commander has been dispatched.$B$BThe guards will head in and clean up the rest of the rabble. We'll see to it that the breaches are sealed and the lower levels reinforced to ensure that no further incursions are possible.$B$BThank ye for yer service to Ironforge, $C. Take this as a small token of my gratitude. Oh, and if ye see that old Wildhammer rockhugger Farsen again, tell 'em to pay me a proper visit.
The Restless Dead
Kill $1oa Enraged Apparitions, $2oa Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.

Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
I don't have time for ghouls and ghosts. I have a job to do down here.
Ah good, it's done then. I can't have the other keepers refusing to enter the hall to do their duties on account of "ghosts" and "angry dead", can I?
An Ancient Grudge
Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest and then return to the Ghostly Attendant in the Hall of Thanes.

The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
<The ghostly figure stares blankly past you. Its mouth is moving, but only low inaudible rasps can be heard.>

My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
Important Heirlooms
Collect $1oa Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.

You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
<Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>

Look at you, as brave as you are enterprising! I'm a gnome of my word, and your reward is well earned! 

Now, let me take a look at the haul--uh, I mean... the recovered heirlooms. I need to get started appraising--excuse me, 'cataloging' them so that they can be put back in their proper places as quickly as possible.
A Visitor to Dun Morogh
Investigate the campsite overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.
Greetings, friend. How are ya?
Battle at the Mannoroc Coven
Investigate the battle at the Mannoroc Coven in Desolace.

$n, I need your aid. One of our brothers passing through Nigel's Point in Desolace overheard details of a battle that took place at the Mannoroc Coven. It was reported that one side brought powerful holy magic to bear in the battle against the warlocks there. Wielders of the light were certainly involved.

I'd like to learn more of who was involved in this skirmish. If one of our people was involved--or fell there... I want to know about it.
The Great Outdoors
Sit near Brakk's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

Lok-tar, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
So now that we've learned the basics, go learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

Camping 101: Cooking
Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.

So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.

With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
The Adventurer
Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.

$n, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.

I appreciate the lookin' out, $c. That marshal's just a worrywart.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

Deliver the Supply Bundle to Eric Brighthammer near Kharanos.

Wait, $n. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?

You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
Well met!

The Adventurer
Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.

Wait, $n. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?

Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

Toast!?
The Witch Doctor's Head
Slay Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring Zum'rah's Head to Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran.

There exists a troll witch doctor that goes by the name of Zum'rah. I have history with this particular troll, and I'd like you to kill him for me.

Go to the Sandfury stronghold of Zul'Farrak, deep in the deserts of Tanaris. Find Zum'rah inside and destroy him. Bring his head to me--intact--and I'll see that you are fairly compensated.
Vengeance of the Highborne
Travel to Krol'dok Stronghold and slay Zalfan Moonshadow.

In the region known as the Riverglades to the southeast, there is a place called the Krol'dok Stronghold. A highborne known as Zalfan Moonshadow has been seen there in the company of the Twilight's Hammer.

I'd pay handsomely if you'd rid the world of this cretin for me. He brings shame to the proud lineage of the highborne by consorting with fanatics and using stolen arcane knowledge in their service. There are few enough of us left without worms like him sullying our good name.
The Dragon's Journal
Recover Zarla's Journal from the depths of Alcaz Prison.

Timear and I have been scrying the area on Kalimdor known as Alcaz Island and we've all but confirmed the presence of a powerful magic user there. The mage in question was able to dispel our probes, but before she did, I was able to glean an image of a tome of some sort. I believe it was a journal, written in ancient draconic script.

I don't know what is in that book, but I'd like to study it. We want you to travel to the hidden prison beneath Alcaz Island and recover that book for us.
The Coldbringer's Eye
Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.

There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb known as "The Coldbringer's Eye" to direct the movements of his lesser minions elsewhere.

Go into Razorfen Downs and retrieve the Coldbringer's Eye on our behalf, $c. The Kirin Tor would pay handsomely to obtain this artifact so that we may study it and understand its inner workings.
Ancient Gurubashi Idol
Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.

The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.

Ol' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.
Zum'rah's Head
Slay Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring Zum'rah's Head to Mazu'kon in Mulgore.

Ol' Mazu'kon got a bone to pick with a Witch Doctor that go by the name of Zum'rah and I be thinkin' you can help me out with that. 

Zum'rah practice all his bad voodoo in the Sandfury city of Zul'Farrak, far to the south in the deserts of Tanaris. Go there. Kill Zum'rah, and bring me his head.

Trust me mon, the world be a better place with his head stuck on pike outside my hut than it be sittin' on his shoulders.
An'she's Radiance
Recover the crystal known as An'she's Radiance from Maraudon.

I have had a vision.

Deep in the place known as Maraudon, past the earth song falls, there is a chamber filled with brilliant white crystals and guarded by mighty giants. At the highest part of this chamber is a crystal of exceptional brilliance. It is an aspect of the sun god, the right eye of the Earthmother herself--An'she.

I've dreamed of its radiance and it calls to me. $c, remove An'she's Radiance from that place and bring it here where it belongs, under the open skies of Mulgore.
Syndicate Sabotage
Find Lord Tomas inside Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills, and kill him. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform.

Sometimes, $r, a single cut in the right place will drop a foe dead. The same is often true of organizations.

Our agents have identified a key target among the ranks of the Syndicate: a man by the name of Lord Tomas.

He plays an instrumental role in the functions of Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you wish to be of service to Ravenholdt, go to Durnholde and eliminate him. The quicker, and quieter, the better.
What's the Big Idea?
Steal Barton's Scouting Report by pickpocketing it from him. Then, bring the report to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.

We have noticed a Syndicate scouting party prowling around the ruins of Alterac, led by a man named Barton.

They're clearly searching for something, but I cannot know what without reading his scouting reports.

I ask that you pickpocket the report from him, rather than killing him outright. Barton's death will tip off the Syndicate that we're on to them, and they will certainly take counter-measures to cover their tracks.

If you hope to find him, he is most likely among the Syndicate at Strahnbrad.
Covert Extraction
Find the Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde among the ruins of Alterac. Then, bring them to Myrokos Silentform.

It seems our friend Barton here has made this very easy for us. He is after two heirlooms of the Perenolde family within the ruins of Alterac. The Blade of House Perenolde, a sword, and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde, a shield.

From the report, it seems these armaments are within two towers among the ruins. Best we acquire them before the Syndicate does.

The ogres occupying the ruins are fierce, but I trust you should be able to sneak past them without needing to bloody your blade at all.
A Way In
Steal a Syndicate uniform from Northfold Manor to infiltrate Stromgarde Keep.

Stromgarde Keep is one of the Syndicate's largest strongholds. Many of the organization's most important dealings take place behind its walls.

I have received word of a certain trade taking place between members of the Syndicate somewhere in Arathi Highlands, and I'm certain the details of this trade can be found somewhere in Stromgarde.

To infiltrate the keep without arousing suspicion, you'll need a disguise. See if you can find one among the Syndicate outside the keep, at Northfold Manor.
Master of Disguise
While disguised as a member of the Syndicate, find someone inside Stromgarde Keep who knows about the secret deal.

<You recall Myrokos' instructions to find out about an important deal going on with the Syndicate in Stromgarde Keep. With your disguise, you should be able to talk to members of the Syndicate somewhat freely. Surely, one of them knows something.>
Ain't No Telling
Find something within Stromgarde Keep to convince Anastasia to give up details of the secret deal.

Who do you think you are? Showing up and sticking your nose in official business.

I'm not telling some rookie anything about the higher-up's dealings without good reason. Unless you've got something important, or valuable, for me, I've got nothing to say to you.
The Syndicate Sting
Break up the secret deal, and take the object being traded to the Syndicate. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.

Falconcrest sent some guys to do a handoff at the southern part of Thoradin's wall. I don't know what they're picking up. Must be good, because everyone involved has kept it a total secret. I don't think the guys picking it up even know what it is.

That's all I've got. Don't make me regret telling you that.
The Orphan
Travel to Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands and locate Sergeant Danneth.

We often try to find surviving family for many of our charges, and occasionally we find something hopeful. I've received word that Randal here may have a surviving family member. The man's name is Danneth, and he is a soldier stationed at Nethergarde Keep. I need someone to travel there and find the man.

If you can, please convince Danneth to come retrieve his nephew. I don't think the two have ever met, but they are family all the same and Randal belongs with him.
Past Due
Retrieve the book The Lost Magic of the Runemasters from the Scarlet Monastery.

You there, $c. I have a matter I could use assistance with.

I just so happen to be writing a thesis on the ancient Wildhammer runemasters of Grim Batol, and there's a particular tome I need to complete my research. According to our ledgers, a mage by the name of Doan checked the book out of the old Dalaran library before the Third War and never returned it!

Arcanist Doan is now holed up in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Retrieve this book for me and you'll be well rewarded.
Legging It
Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.

We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, $N. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
For Honor
Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.

We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
Have you done what I asked?
These warriors will always be remembered, $N. You have made sure of that.
This Fruit Could Bite Back
Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.

Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
Did you find the fruits?
I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!
A Pain in the Neck
Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.

The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!
What do you have for me, $N?
Fine work. A shame about the slain trolls, but with the binding spells removed, their spirits can rest.
This Is Spinal Axe
Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.

Have you seen the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge? I keep thinking the spines on their backs would be perfect for crafting the head of a mighty axe. Saru laughed when I told him... but what does he know!?

As part of your smithing lessons, you can help me out! Bring me some of those spines, along with grinding stones to sharpen them.
Beasts of Thunder Ridge
Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.

Orgrimmar is always expanding, $c. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
Ukor's Lost Pack
Return the pack to Ukor in southern Durotar.
The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.
Halikor's Hoof
Deliver Halikor's Hoof to Orgrimmar.
The enormous hoof serves as proof of your victory over the mighty lizard.
Yes?
What a trophy, $c! That must have been some fight!
The Argent Emissary
Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.

Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
Stay low and try not to be seen, $c. These cultists are not to be trifled with.
A Righteous Cause
Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.

Danitha and I fought against the Scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the Forsaken felt the same way...

I plan to stay here for a time and speak with more of my friends, but I will return to Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands soon enough. Should you ever find yourself out that way, please do say hello. We could always use more help from able-bodied adventurers.
The Cult of the Damned
Kill $1oa Dark Neophytes and $2oa Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.

The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
Thank you for your aid, $c. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.
Remnants of War
Gather $1oa Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.

It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.
I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.

Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the Scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.
Bandarion Keep
Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.

This place is full of memories for me. This place was once held by the Argent Dawn. It was from here that we prepared for many battles and skirmishes against the Scourge during their most recent push into Tirisfal Glades.$B$BWhen we withdrew to the Plaguelands I feared it would fall into disrepair. My fear was well-founded, but I am glad that Danitha and her paladins have taken over stewardship of it now.$B$BShe even named the keep after... a mutual friend.
Your First Riding Kodo
Inspect the riding kodos to choose your first mount.

Ah, I've been expecting you, $c. It would seem the winds have brought you to me this day. You have come seeking a kodo, correct?

The kodo is a noble beast that is slow to anger, and you would be hard pressed to find a more dependable companion.

Today you have an important choice to make. You and your kodo will travel the world together, so find which one speaks to you. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go examine the kodos and return to me when you have made your choice.
Heart of Disruption
Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.

Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
The Grave Knight
Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.

Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $n, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
Opportunistic Education
Collect the Founding of Dalaran from the City of Dalaran for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.

Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into Dalaran durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.

My kinda $r!

While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.

Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?
Source of Power
Collect $1oa Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.

With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
Your First Riding Galestrider
Inspect the riding striders to choose your first mount.

Now that you have completed your training, it would seem the winds wish you to bond with your first strider.

These galestriders have been ridden by our ancestors for generations. Despite their wispy and slender appearance, they are steadfast and fierce mounts.

You and your strider will traverse the world together, so you have an important choice to make. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go examine the striders and return to me when you have made your choice.
A Steed in Death as They Were in Life
Inspect the undead riding horses to choose your first mount.

Greetings, $c. I imagine I can guess what has brought you to my stables today.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place. Be warned though, riding an undead steed is not for the faint of heart.

As such, you have an important choice to make. You and your undead steed will travel the world together for good or ill. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the correct one.

Go examine the undead horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
